title: Mexican Gothic
author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
summary: In 1950, a Mexico City socialite travels to a remote mountain house after her newly married cousin sends an alarming letter. The decaying mansion and its strange family are not what they first appear.
readIf: you like gothic horror with a sharp, stylish heroine and an unsettling old house.
skipIf: you dislike body horror or a slow reveal of what is wrong.

pairings.reason: The classic haunted-house story that this one draws on, quieter and more ambiguous.
A gothic about a young woman in an unwelcoming family estate, with the mystery of a former wife.
Another atmospheric novel that mixes old family secrets with something unnatural.
